releaseNotes: Added Smart File Transfer with LAN transfer, Direct Host support, and manual WebRTC P2P fallback using bundled libdatachannel.
Bundled and linked the native WebRTC/OpenSSL pieces needed for Smart File Transfer so no extra WebRTC install is required.
Added a new Smart File Transfer tool icon and improved the P2P pairing flow with safer sender/receiver session handling.
Improved Smart File Transfer reliability around STUN settings, approval/denial messages, stale pairing state, and long P2P downloads.
